fullDescription: Send-It is a premium logistics and SaaS dashboard style guide characterized by a sophisticated palette of Deep Sapphire (#002D72) and Golden Pulse (#F9A825) set against a Luxe Ivory (#FFF8E1) background. The design features a high-contrast editorial aesthetic with generous white space, refined borders, and a bento-grid layout for delivery management. It uses the Inter font family for a modern, functional feel, making it ideal for fintech, logistics, supply chain management, and high-end enterprise dashboards. The visual language emphasizes trust through clean 1px borders, subtle drop shadows, and pill-shaped status indicators.

structured.summary: A high-end, professional logistics dashboard design featuring a sapphire and gold color scheme, ivory backgrounds, and card-based data visualization for real-time tracking and account management.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Premium Corporate' aesthetic. Typography uses 'Inter' in varying weights (400-800) to create a clear hierarchy. The color palette centers on #002D72 (Sapphire) for authority, #F9A825 (Golden) for action/highlights, and #FFF8E1 (Ivory) for a softer, premium background feel. Borders are strictly 1px solid #E0DDD6, and card corners are rounded at 16px. Animations are subtle, limited to 200ms ease-in-out transforms and opacity shifts.
style.prompt: Create a design system using 'Inter' font. Colors: Primary Sapphire (#002D72), Accent Gold (#F9A825), Success Emerald (#10B981), Link Royal Blue (#1E88E5), Surface Ivory (#FFF8E1), and Border Gray (#E0DDD6). Typography: H2 at 32px (Bold), H3 at 24px (SemiBold), Body at 14px (Regular), and Labels at 11px (Bold Uppercase with 0.1em tracking). UI elements: Cards must have #FFFFFF background, 1px #E0DDD6 border, 16px border-radius, and shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Buttons: Primary is #F9A825 background with #002D72 text, 10px radius, bold; Secondary is #002D72 outline with 2px weight. Interactive states: hover scale 1.02 and 0.9 opacity. Icons: Lucide-style, 24px for headers, 18px for actions.

layout_and_structure.description: A responsive 2-column bento-grid layout for desktop that stacks into a single column for mobile. Features a fixed top navigation and a mobile-specific bottom tab bar.

prompts.prompt: Sticky 64px height header. Background: #FFFFFF, Border-bottom: 1px #E0DDD6. Left: Logo in Sapphire (#002D72) with a 32px icon container. Center: Navigation links ('Send', 'Track', 'Manage') using 14px Inter 600 Sapphire text; active link has a 2px Golden (#F9A825) bottom border. Right: Profile section with a 40px circular avatar and 12px bold uppercase name label.
Max-width 1200px, centered. Background: #FFF8E1. Padding: 32px horizontally, 24px vertically. Layout: Two-column grid with 32px gap between cards.

Full-width or large-column card. Features a top header with H3 title and a 'Track' primary button. Inner 'Highlight' box with #F4F1EC background, 12px radius, showing destination and status pill. Below highlight, a vertical timeline: 2px gray line (#D1D5DB) with 16px circular markers. Markers color-coded: Completed (Emerald #10B981 with check), Active (Golden #F9A825 with arrow), Pending (Gray #D1D5DB).

Standard card structure. Header with H3 and a 'View All' royal blue link or secondary button. Content: Vertical list of items separated by 1px #E0DDD6 dividers. Each row: 14px bold title, 12px gray secondary text, and a right-aligned pill badge (11px bold uppercase). Hover state for rows: background #F9F8F6.

Fixed bottom bar 72px height. Background: #FFFFFF, Border-top: 1px #E0DDD6. Four icons evenly spaced: Dashboard, Send, Track, Account. Active state: Royal Blue (#1E88E5), Inactive: Gray (#666666). Labels: 9px bold uppercase.

special_ui_components.prompt: Pill-shaped container with 6px 12px padding. Typography: 11px Inter 700, Uppercase. Variants: Active (Gold bg, Sapphire text), Quoted (Sapphire 10% opacity bg, Sapphire text), Expired (Gray 30% bg, Gray 600 text), Success (Emerald bg, White text).

Vertical 2px track. Completed segments in Emerald (#10B981). Active nodes: 16px circle, Golden (#F9A825) with a 4px soft ring (ring-orange-50). Labels: 14px bold for step title, 10px gray for timestamp.

structured.special_notes: MUST use #FFF8E1 for the page background to avoid a 'sterile' look. DO NOT use vibrant red for errors; prefer muted tones. Ensure all pill badges have tracking-wider (0.05em to 0.1em) for readability. ALL buttons must have a height of at least 44px for mobile accessibility.
